quarterly_data.quarter: Allegro MicroSystems press release: Allegro MicroSystems Unveils 48V Power and Precision (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Allegro MicroSystems expanded its robotics portfolio for humanoid robots with 48V power and precision sensing: the A81481 48V power management IC (Allegro says it reduces system footprint and hardware costs by 50%), the A17802 and A17803 inductive position sensors. Sarcomere Dynamics CEO Harpal J.S. Mandaher: Sarcomere integrates Allegro's motion controllers, sensors and power ICs into its Scorpion gripper and is on track to extend the collaboration to its next-generation ARTUS Dex robotic hand.
